Violin plots of a Boxplot performance indicator, pooled over OMs

Source: R/Slick_plots.R
PlotViolin.Rd

Wraps Slick::plotBoxplot() (type = 'violin'). Each violin shows the distribution of a per-simulation performance indicator for one MP, pooled over the simulations of the selected OMs, so its spread includes both the simulation and the OM uncertainty. The mean of each OM can be overlaid as points, with a reference OM (e.g. the Base Case) highlighted, which shows the robustness of each MP across the OMs on the same plot.

Usage

PlotViolin(
  slick,
  PI = 1,
  MPs = NULL,
  OMs = NULL,
  pool = c("pool", "mean"),
  x_by = NULL,
  fill_by = NULL,
  colors = NULL,
  OM_means = TRUE,
  ref_OM = 1,
  quants = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75),
  alpha = 0.45,
  ylim = NULL,
  ylab = NULL,
  xlab = NULL,
  fill_title = NULL,
  base_size = 11,
  base_family = "serif"
)

Arguments

slick

A Slick object.

PI

Index or code of the Boxplot performance indicator.

MPs

Codes or indices of the MPs. Defaults to all.

OMs

Codes or indices of the OMs to pool. Defaults to all.

pool

'pool' or 'mean' (see Details).

x_by, fill_by

Vectors (one per MP, or named by MP code) giving the x-axis group and fill of each MP. Defaults: MP code, and no grouping.

colors

Optional colours for the levels of fill_by.

OM_means

Overlay the mean of each OM as points?

ref_OM

Code or index of the OM highlighted (diamond) among the OM means. NULL for none.

quants

Quantiles drawn as lines inside the violins (NULL for none).

alpha

Transparency of the violin fill.

ylim

Optional y-axis limits.

ylab, xlab, fill_title

Labels.

base_size, base_family

Passed to theme_slick_print().

Value

A ggplot2 object.
